svg.title: Trim: Before and After
svg.desc: Instructional comparison graphic showing how motor trim corrects a robot that curves left. The simplified robot icons have been replaced by the authentic top-view Zumo image with transparent background. All labels remain live SVG text.
svg.text: but real motors are never twins.
A small boost to the weaker LEFT motor
Curves LEFT = LEFT motor weak = positive TRIM boosts the left.
Your robot's TRIM number will be different from +15 — find yours with the adjustment loop.
